metadata.title: Neon Dragon riddle pool

license.name: All rights reserved (original work for this project)

metadata.notes: Original riddles written for this game. Each riddle encounter draws one at random; no repeats within a game.

riddles.question: Which animal is hiding inside the word CATERPILLAR?
riddles.explain: CATerpillar starts with CAT.

riddles.question: Which TWO animals are hiding inside the word SCOWL?
riddles.explain: s-COW-l and sc-OWL.

riddles.question: Which planet is hiding inside the word HEARTH?
riddles.explain: h-EARTH.

riddles.question: Which number is hiding inside the word OFTEN?
riddles.explain: of-TEN.

riddles.question: Which number is hiding inside the word WEIGHT?
riddles.explain: w-EIGHT.

riddles.question: Which number is hiding inside the word STONE?
riddles.explain: st-ONE.

riddles.question: Which part of your body is hiding inside the word SHEARS?
riddles.explain: sh-EAR-s.

riddles.question: Write STRESSED backwards. What tasty word do you get?
riddles.explain: S-T-R-E-S-S-E-D backwards is D-E-S-S-E-R-T-S.

riddles.question: Which of these words reads the same forwards and backwards?
riddles.explain: L-E-V-E-L backwards is still LEVEL.

riddles.question: Which of these is a palindrome, the same spelled backwards?
riddles.explain: R-A-C-E-C-A-R reads the same both ways.

riddles.question: Which letter can go in front of RAIN to make the thing you think with?
riddles.explain: B + RAIN = BRAIN. (TRAIN and GRAIN are real words, but you don't think with them!)

riddles.question: Which letter can go in front of EAR to make a big furry animal?
riddles.explain: B + EAR = BEAR.

riddles.question: Change ONE letter in COLD to get a shiny yellow metal.
riddles.explain: C becomes G: GOLD.

riddles.question: Change ONE letter in BOAT to get an animal with horns.
riddles.explain: B becomes G: GOAT. Hello, Loulou!

riddles.question: Which word can go in front of FLY, CUP and MILK to make three new words?
riddles.explain: Butterfly, buttercup, buttermilk.

riddles.question: Which word can go in front of BOW, COAT and DROP to make three new words?
riddles.explain: Rainbow, raincoat, raindrop.

riddles.question: Which word can go after SUN, MOON and STAR to make three new words?
riddles.explain: Sunlight, moonlight, starlight.

riddles.question: Which word can go after TOOTH, HAIR and PAINT to make three new words?
riddles.explain: Toothbrush, hairbrush, paintbrush.

riddles.question: I sound just like a letter of the alphabet, and I buzz from flower to flower. What am I?
riddles.explain: BEE sounds like the letter B.

riddles.question: Which drink sounds exactly like a letter of the alphabet?
riddles.explain: TEA sounds like the letter T.

riddles.question: Which word sounds like a letter and means a huge body of salty water?
riddles.explain: SEA sounds like the letter C.

riddles.question: Which bird's name sounds exactly like a letter of the alphabet?
riddles.explain: JAY sounds like the letter J.

riddles.question: Which of these words uses all five vowels A, E, I, O and U?
riddles.explain: e-d-U-c-A-t-I-O-n has A, E, I, O and U.

riddles.question: Mix up the letters of LISTEN. Which word can you make?
riddles.explain: L-I-S-T-E-N and S-I-L-E-N-T use exactly the same letters.

riddles.question: Mix up the letters of NIGHT to make another word.
riddles.explain: N-I-G-H-T rearranges to T-H-I-N-G.

riddles.question: Mix up the letters of EARTH to make a part of your body.
riddles.explain: E-A-R-T-H rearranges to H-E-A-R-T.

riddles.question: Mix up the letters of DUSTY to make something you do at school.
riddles.explain: D-U-S-T-Y rearranges to S-T-U-D-Y.

riddles.question: Mix up the letters of MELON to make a sour yellow fruit.
riddles.explain: M-E-L-O-N rearranges to L-E-M-O-N.

riddles.question: Mix up the letters of PEACH to make a word that means 'doesn't cost much'.
riddles.explain: P-E-A-C-H rearranges to C-H-E-A-P.

riddles.question: Which of these words is made from TWO animal names stuck together?
riddles.explain: DOG + FISH (and a dogfish is a real small shark!).

riddles.question: Which word means both a flying mammal AND the thing you hit a ball with in cricket?
riddles.explain: A bat flies at night, and a cricket bat hits the ball.

riddles.question: Which word means both the outside of a tree trunk AND the noise a dog makes?
riddles.explain: Trees have bark, and dogs bark.

riddles.question: Which word means both a shape on playing cards AND a sparkly gem?
riddles.explain: Diamonds are a card suit and a gemstone.

riddles.question: Which word means both the inside of your hand AND a tree you see on beaches?
riddles.explain: The palm of your hand, and a palm tree.

riddles.question: Which word means both a season of the year AND a bouncy jump?
riddles.explain: Spring is a season, and to spring is to jump.

riddles.question: Which word means both the edge of a river AND a place that keeps your money safe?
riddles.explain: A river bank, and a bank for money.

riddles.question: Which is the odd one out?
riddles.explain: Kitten, puppy and calf are all baby animals. A lion is a grown-up!

riddles.question: Which word is the opposite of ANCIENT?
riddles.explain: Ancient means very old, so modern is the opposite.

riddles.question: Take the first letter off PLATE. Which word is left?
riddles.explain: P-LATE without the P is LATE.

riddles.question: Which word turns into a different word when you add an E to the end: KIT, BOX or CUP?
riddles.explain: KIT + E = KITE. BOXE and CUPE aren't words.

riddles.question: Mei is taller than Kai. Kai is taller than Sam. Who is the shortest?
riddles.explain: Mei > Kai > Sam, so Sam is the shortest.

riddles.question: Tam is older than Ana but younger than Leo. Who is the oldest?
riddles.explain: Ana < Tam < Leo.

riddles.question: Siu Mai the cat is waiting in a queue. There are 3 cats in front of her and 2 cats behind her. How many cats are in the queue?
riddles.explain: 3 in front + Siu Mai + 2 behind = 6.

riddles.question: A tram line has 5 stops in a row. Going from one stop to the next takes 2 minutes. How long from the first stop to the last?
riddles.explain: 5 stops have 4 gaps between them: 4 x 2 = 8.

riddles.question: What comes next? 2, 4, 8, 16, ...
riddles.explain: Each number doubles.

riddles.question: What comes next? 1, 4, 9, 16, ...
riddles.explain: These are 1x1, 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, so next is 5x5.

riddles.question: What comes next? A, C, E, G, ...
riddles.explain: Skip one letter each time: G, (H), I.

riddles.question: What comes next? Monday, Wednesday, Friday, ...
riddles.explain: Skip one day each time: Friday, (Saturday), Sunday.

riddles.question: What comes next? 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...
riddles.explain: Add the two numbers before: 5 + 8 = 13.

riddles.question: What comes next? 100, 90, 81, 73, ...
riddles.explain: Take away 10, then 9, then 8, then 7: 73 - 7 = 66.

riddles.question: All glimmerfish are blue. Dot is a glimmerfish. What colour is Dot?
riddles.explain: Every glimmerfish is blue, and Dot is one.

riddles.question: Some dragons are green. Puff is a dragon. Is Puff green?
riddles.explain: Only SOME dragons are green, so Puff might be, or might not be.

riddles.question: A drawer holds red socks and blue socks, all mixed up. In the dark, how many socks must you grab to be SURE you have two of the same colour?
riddles.explain: With 3 socks and only 2 colours, two of them must match.

riddles.question: Four friends each shake hands once with every other friend. How many handshakes is that?
If yesterday was Saturday, what day will tomorrow be?
riddles.explain: Today is Sunday, so tomorrow is Monday.

riddles.question: The day after tomorrow is Thursday. What day is it today?
riddles.explain: Tuesday, then Wednesday, then Thursday.

riddles.question: I'm thinking of a number. I double it and add 3, and I get 11. What is my number?
riddles.explain: 11 - 3 = 8, and half of 8 is 4.

riddles.question: A farmer has some chickens and some cows. Together they have 4 heads and 12 legs. How many cows are there?
riddles.explain: 2 cows (8 legs) + 2 chickens (4 legs) = 12 legs.

riddles.question: In a running race you are in 4th place, and you overtake the runner in 3rd. What place are you in now?
riddles.explain: You took their place: 3rd.

riddles.question: Which weighs more: one kilogram of fluffy marshmallows or one kilogram of rocks?
riddles.explain: A kilogram is a kilogram!

riddles.question: Liv has more stickers than Kit. Kit has more than Bo. Bo has more than Dee. Who has the fewest stickers?
riddles.explain: Liv > Kit > Bo > Dee.

riddles.question: Three lanterns hang in a row. The red one is in the middle. The gold one is NOT on the left. Where is the green one?
riddles.explain: Red is in the middle, gold must be on the right, so green is on the left.

riddles.question: Which number is the odd one out? 3, 7, 12, 15, 21
riddles.explain: 12 is the only even number.

riddles.question: Which is the odd one out?
riddles.explain: A cube is a solid 3D shape. The others are flat.

riddles.question: Which is the odd one out?
riddles.explain: Mercury, Mars and Venus are planets. The Moon goes round the Earth.

riddles.question: Which is the odd one out?
riddles.explain: A dolphin is a mammal that breathes air. The others are fish.

riddles.question: Which is the odd one out?
riddles.explain: A bat is a mammal. The others are birds.

riddles.question: Which is the odd one out?
riddles.explain: A drum has no strings.

riddles.question: Kai faces north. He turns right, then turns right again. Which way is he facing now?
riddles.explain: North, turn right to east, turn right again to south.

riddles.question: You are facing east. You turn left twice. Which way are you facing now?
riddles.explain: East, left to north, left again to west.

riddles.question: Which number is missing? 3, 6, __, 12, 15
riddles.explain: Count up in 3s.

riddles.question: In a secret code A=1, B=2, C=3 and so on. What does 3-1-20 spell?
riddles.explain: C is 3, A is 1, T is 20.

riddles.question: If A=1, B=2, C=3 and so on, what do the letters of BAD add up to?
A clock on the wall shows 3 o'clock. What time does it seem to show in a mirror?
riddles.explain: A mirror flips left and right, so the hour hand points to 9.

riddles.question: Pip stands between Ann and Cal in a line of three. Ann is first. Who is last?
riddles.explain: Ann, Pip, Cal.

riddles.question: Five friends sit around a round table. How many people is each friend sitting right next to?
riddles.explain: One on the left and one on the right.

riddles.question: A week from today will be a Friday. What day was it yesterday?
riddles.explain: A week later is the same day, so today is Friday and yesterday was Thursday.

riddles.question: A ferry leaves every 15 minutes. One leaves at 10:00. When do the next two leave?
riddles.explain: Add 15 minutes each time.

riddles.question: Box A is heavier than Box B. Box C is lighter than Box B. Which box is the lightest?
riddles.explain: A > B > C.

riddles.question: Some of the gremlins are purple. All of the gremlins love noodles. Which MUST be true?
riddles.explain: All gremlins love noodles, so the purple ones do too.

riddles.question: Which of these animals is a mammal that can really fly, not just glide?
riddles.explain: Bats flap real wings. Flying fish and flying squirrels only glide.

riddles.question: How many legs does a spider have?
How many legs does an insect, like an ant or a beetle, have?
A hungry caterpillar wraps itself up and waits. What can it turn into?
Which planet is called the Red Planet?
riddles.explain: Its rusty dust makes it look red.

riddles.question: What is the closest star to Earth?
riddles.explain: The Sun is a star! The Moon and Mars aren't stars at all.

riddles.question: Plants breathe in a gas from the air to help make their food. Which gas?
riddles.explain: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen.

riddles.question: What sweet, sticky food do honeybees make?
Which is the biggest ocean on Earth?
At what temperature does pure water freeze into ice?
At sea level, at what temperature does water boil?
What is the biggest animal that has ever lived on Earth?
riddles.explain: Blue whales are even bigger than the biggest dinosaurs.

riddles.question: A frog begins its life as a tiny swimming...
Which bird can't fly but is the fastest runner of all birds?
Which part of a plant drinks up water from the soil?
Which of these animals carries its baby in a pouch?
How many hearts does an octopus have?
riddles.explain: Two pump blood to the gills and one pumps it round the body.

riddles.question: A snake flicks its tongue in and out. What is it doing?
riddles.explain: Snakes pick up smells with their tongues.

riddles.question: Which of these is NOT a mammal?
riddles.explain: Sharks are fish. Whales, bats and dolphins are mammals.

riddles.question: What do we call an animal that eats only plants?
In Hong Kong, typhoons mostly come in which part of the year?
Pink Chinese white dolphins can be spotted in the sea near which Hong Kong island?
riddles.explain: Many live in the waters west of Lantau, near Tai O.

riddles.question: Why does the Moon shine at night?
options: It reflects light from the Sun

riddles.question: About how long does the Earth take to travel once around the Sun?
About how long does the Earth take to spin around once?
What do you need to make a rainbow?
Which of these animals is a reptile?
riddles.explain: Frogs are amphibians, salmon are fish, ducks are birds.

riddles.question: A baby lion is called a...
What do giant pandas eat most of the time?
Which is the biggest planet in our Solar System?
In which direction does the Sun rise in the morning?
How many arms does a common starfish have?
Which of these animals is famous for changing the colour of its skin?
Most penguins live in which half of the world?
riddles.explain: Penguins live south of the Equator (and there are none at the North Pole).

riddles.question: What do we call a big group of fish swimming together?
Which is the fastest animal on land?
Mangrove trees, like the ones at Mai Po in Hong Kong, grow best where?
Which animal sleeps hanging upside down by its feet?
How many bones does a grown-up human body usually have?
What is the biggest organ of your body?
riddles.explain: Skin covers your whole body!

riddles.question: How many animals are there in the Chinese zodiac?
Which animal comes FIRST in the Chinese zodiac?
Which zodiac animal comes straight after the Rat?
Which is the only animal in the Chinese zodiac that isn't real?
riddles.explain: Dragons are mythical. (Don't tell the Neon Dragon!)

riddles.question: Which animal comes LAST in the Chinese zodiac?
Which zodiac animal comes just before the Dog?
riddles.explain: ... Monkey, Rooster, Dog, Pig.

riddles.question: In the old story of the Great Race, which clever animal rode on the Ox's back and hopped off at the end to win?
In the legend of the Great Race, which animal missed out on the zodiac because the Rat tricked it?
riddles.explain: That's why, people say, cats chase rats!

riddles.question: 2025 was the Year of the Snake. Which animal's year is 2026?
riddles.explain: Snake, then Horse.

riddles.question: How many years does it take for the same zodiac animal to come round again?
The zodiac Goat has other English names too. Which is one of them?
riddles.explain: The Goat is also called the Sheep or the Ram.

riddles.question: At Chinese New Year, what colour are the lucky money envelopes?
What do people in Hong Kong call the lucky red money packets?
Which greeting do people say for Chinese New Year?
During a lion dance, what does the lion stretch up high to 'eat'?
riddles.explain: Lettuce sounds like 'growing wealth' in Cantonese.

riddles.question: What round treat do people share at the Mid-Autumn Festival?
At which festival do children carry glowing lanterns under the big full moon?
What do people eat at the Dragon Boat Festival?
options: Sticky rice dumplings wrapped in leaves
riddles.explain: They're called zongzi (joong in Cantonese).

riddles.question: Long, colourful boats race to the beat of a drum at which festival?
At which festival do families visit and sweep their ancestors' graves?
In Cantonese, which number is lucky because it sounds like 'getting rich'?
Which number do many people avoid in Hong Kong because it sounds like the word for 'death'?
What does the name 'Hong Kong' mean in English?
The green-and-white Star Ferry sails across which harbour?
Victoria Harbour lies between Hong Kong Island and...
What nickname do people give Hong Kong Island's double-decker trams?
riddles.explain: From the sound of their bells!

riddles.question: What is the highest mountain in Hong Kong?
Which is the biggest island in Hong Kong?
The giant bronze Big Buddha sits on top of a hill on which island?
What is the name of Hong Kong's underground railway?
Which card do people tap to pay for the MTR, buses and even snacks in Hong Kong?
Taxis in the busy city areas of Hong Kong are which colour?
riddles.explain: Green taxis serve the New Territories and blue ones serve Lantau.

riddles.question: Which colour taxis drive around Lantau Island?
Yuenyeung is a Hong Kong café drink made by mixing milk tea with...
A pineapple bun usually has no pineapple in it. So why is it called a pineapple bun?
options: Its crunchy golden top looks like a pineapple
It was invented on a pineapple farm
It's shaped like a palm tree

riddles.question: In Cantonese, what do you say to thank someone for a present?
riddles.explain: Zou san means good morning, and nei hou means hello.

riddles.question: The Chinese character 山 looks like three peaks. What does it mean?
The Chinese character 人 looks like someone walking. What does it mean?
What number does the Chinese character 三 stand for?
riddles.explain: Three lines, three!

riddles.question: Temple Street in Kowloon is famous for its busy...
Siu Mai the cat eats 3 fish balls every hour. How many fish balls does he eat in 4 hours?
A bamboo steamer holds 4 dumplings. How many dumplings are in 6 steamers?
What is half of 50, plus 10?
riddles.explain: Half of 50 is 25, and 25 + 10 = 35.

riddles.question: What is 7 x 8?
What is 9 x 6?
What is 144 divided by 12?
What is a quarter of 100?
How many minutes are there in 2 hours?
How many seconds are there in 3 minutes?
How many days are there in a leap year?
Which number is bigger?
riddles.explain: 0.5 is the same as 0.50, which is more than 0.45.

riddles.question: What is one half plus one quarter?
What is 47 rounded to the nearest ten?
A triangle has one angle of 90 degrees and one of 30 degrees. How big is the third angle?
riddles.explain: The angles in a triangle add up to 180: 180 - 90 - 30 = 60.

riddles.question: How many sides does a hexagon have?
A square has sides 5 cm long. What is the distance all the way around it?
riddles.explain: 4 sides x 5 cm = 20 cm.

riddles.question: A rectangle is 4 cm wide and 6 cm long. What is its area?
What is 10% of 200?
riddles.explain: 10% means one tenth, and a tenth of 200 is 20.

riddles.question: Which of these numbers is a prime number?
riddles.explain: 11 can only be divided by 1 and 11. 9 = 3x3, 15 = 3x5, 21 = 3x7.

riddles.question: What is 3 squared (3 x 3)?
You have 20 tokens. You spend 7, then win 5. How many tokens do you have now?
A ferry leaves at 9:45 and the trip takes 10 minutes. When does it arrive?
A film starts at 6:30 pm and lasts 1 hour and 45 minutes. When does it finish?
Egg tarts cost $8 each. How much do 5 egg tarts cost?
You pay $50 for a toy that costs $36. How much change do you get?
Which fraction is the same as three sixths?
riddles.explain: 3 out of 6 is half.

riddles.question: How many centimetres are there in one metre?
How many grams are there in one kilogram?
What is double 45?
What is 1000 take away 1?
What number is the Roman numeral X?
How do you write the number 4 in Roman numerals?
riddles.explain: IV means one less than five. (Some old clocks use IIII, but IV is the usual way.)

riddles.question: The three angles inside any triangle always add up to...
How many flat faces does a cube have?
How many edges does a cube have?
riddles.explain: 4 round the top, 4 round the bottom and 4 going up the sides.

riddles.question: Counting in 5s starting at 5 (5, 10, 15...), what is the 10th number you say?
Which of these numbers is odd?
How many quarters are there in 3 whole pizzas?
riddles.explain: Each pizza has 4 quarters: 3 x 4 = 12.

riddles.question: A pizza is cut into 8 equal slices and you eat 3. What fraction of the pizza is left?
riddles.explain: 8 - 3 = 5 slices left out of 8.

riddles.question: Which is bigger: 3 x 4, or 2 x 7?
